description: Primary Health Networks and locator map is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the Regional Data Hub group and published by Department of Health and Aged Care. Members: Primary Health Network (PHN) locator map; Primary Health Networks (PHNs). Example entry: An interactive map that allows users to identify their local Primary Health Network (PHN) region, produced by the Department of Health and Aged Care. Users can find the PHN for a location by clicking the map or searching for an address. Overlays are available for electorates and Statistical Area Level 3. Coverage is Australia, 2021 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (2 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
